\section[(dialogue)]{The body — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R147-first-pass-the-body}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for kind and angry.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a palm, a fingernail, a brain, a heel, a lip
  \item a tongue, a belly, a leg, skin, a bone
  \item a bicycle, a ship, a traveller, a factory, a square
  \item an eraser, a class, a student, a job, a salary
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A palm? (\textbf{\ar{كف}}, \emph{kaff}.) A fingernail? (\textbf{\ar{ظفر}}, \emph{ẓufr}.) A brain? (\textbf{\ar{دماغ}}, \emph{dimāgh}.) A heel? (\textbf{\ar{كعب}}, \emph{kaʿb}.) A lip? (\textbf{\ar{شفة}}, \emph{shafa}.) A tongue? (\textbf{\ar{لسان}}, \emph{lisān}.) A belly? (\textbf{\ar{بطن}}, \emph{baṭn}.) A leg? (\textbf{\ar{ساق}}, \emph{sāq}.) Skin? (\textbf{\ar{جلد}}, \emph{jild}.) A bone? (\textbf{\ar{عظم}}, \emph{ʿaẓm}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\ar{دراجة}}, \emph{darrāja}.) A ship? (\textbf{\ar{سفينة}}, \emph{safīna}.) A traveller? (\textbf{\ar{مسافر}}, \emph{musāfir}.) A factory? (\textbf{\ar{مصنع}}, \emph{maṣnaʿ}.) A square? (\textbf{\ar{ساحة}}, \emph{sāḥa}.) An eraser? (\textbf{\ar{ممحاة}}, \emph{mimḥāh}.) A class? (\textbf{\ar{صف}}, \emph{ṣaff}.) A student? (\textbf{\ar{طالب}}, \emph{ṭālib}.) A job? (\textbf{\ar{وظيفة}}, \emph{waẓīfa}.) A salary? (\textbf{\ar{راتب}}, \emph{rātib}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Town, school and work — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R147-second-pass-town-school-and-work}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tailor and a carpenter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a tailor, a carpenter, a baker, a farmer, a university
  \item salty, luxurious, simple, comfortable, famous
  \item useful, dangerous, safe, open, closed
  \item busy, tired, active, kind, angry
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A tailor? (\textbf{\ar{خياط}}, \emph{khayyāṭ}.) A carpenter? (\textbf{\ar{نجار}}, \emph{najjār}.) A baker? (\textbf{\ar{خباز}}, \emph{khabbāz}.) A farmer? (\textbf{\ar{مزارع}}, \emph{muzāriʿ}.) A university? (\textbf{\ar{جامعة}}, \emph{jāmiʿa}.) Salty? (\textbf{\ar{مالح}}, \emph{māliḥ}.) Luxurious? (\textbf{\ar{فخم}}, \emph{fakhm}.) Simple? (\textbf{\ar{بسيط}}, \emph{basīṭ}.) Comfortable? (\textbf{\ar{مريح}}, \emph{murīḥ}.) Famous? (\textbf{\ar{مشهور}}, \emph{mashhūr}.) Useful? (\textbf{\ar{مفيد}}, \emph{mufīd}.) Dangerous? (\textbf{\ar{خطير}}, \emph{khaṭīr}.) Safe? (\textbf{\ar{آمن}}, \emph{āmin}.) Open? (\textbf{\ar{مفتوح}}, \emph{maftūḥ}.) Closed? (\textbf{\ar{مغلق}}, \emph{mughlaq}.) Busy? (\textbf{\ar{مشغول}}, \emph{mashghūl}.) Tired? (\textbf{\ar{متعب}}, \emph{mutʿab}.) Active? (\textbf{\ar{نشيط}}, \emph{nashīṭ}.) Kind? (\textbf{\ar{لطيف}}, \emph{laṭīf}.) Angry? (\textbf{\ar{غاضب}}, \emph{ghāḍib}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
